meta.title: Doubao / GPT Images
meta.description: Brings web Doubao and free-tier ChatGPT image generation into DSH, with image editing, video and a gallery.

doubao.title: Doubao
doubao.description: Scan the QR code once and the free account can generate images; the cookie is kept in the DSH credential vault.
doubao.scanHint: Scan the QR code below with the Doubao app
doubao.scanned: Scanned — please confirm on your phone
doubao.expired: QR code expired, please request a new one
doubao.cookieHint: Copy the Cookie header of www.doubao.com from DevTools; sessionid is required

gpt.title: Free-tier ChatGPT
gpt.description: Uses the free account's web image generation; sign in once so the access token can be read.
gpt.edgeLoginHint: Opens a separate Edge window (your own browser is untouched) and reads the credentials once you finish signing in.
gpt.tokenHint: Copy accessToken from chatgpt.com/api/auth/session; it stays valid for about two weeks.
gpt.proxyHint: chatgpt.com requires a proxy; leave empty for a direct connection.

settings.title: General
settings.timeoutHint: Overall timeout for one generation, shared by Doubao and GPT.
settings.defaultSizeHint: e.g. 1024x1024; snapped to Doubao's supported 1:1 / 4:3 / 16:9 / 9:16 ratios.
settings.videoHint: Off by default. Doubao video is slow and uses the daily free quota.
settings.videoRemoveWatermarkHint: On (default): download Doubao's watermark-free stream. Off: keep the burned-in "Doubao AI generated" watermark, for platforms that require labeling AI content.
settings.reuseConversationHint: When on, every image goes into the same Doubao conversation so the account keeps only one. Use "New conversation" to switch style. When off, each image starts a new conversation.
settings.newConversationHint: The next image starts a new conversation (used to switch style in pinned mode).
settings.newConversationDone: Switched. The next image starts a new conversation.
settings.newConversationNoAccount: No Doubao account yet — sign in first.
settings.invalidNumber: Timeout and duration must be positive integers
settings.invalidSize: Size must look like WIDTHxHEIGHT, e.g. 1024x1024

gallery.title: Gallery
gallery.enabledHint: When off, newly generated images are no longer recorded locally (existing records stay).
gallery.noRoute: The host exposes no image route, so thumbnails cannot be loaded.
gallery.unavailable: This browser has no IndexedDB support; the gallery is unavailable.
gallery.empty: The gallery is empty — generate an image and it appears here.
gallery.confirmClear: Clear the whole gallery (including deletion records)? This cannot be undone.

common.notApplied: Write did not take effect; check the current settings
common.credentialsUnavailable: Credential service unavailable; the sign-in state cannot be saved
